paint_atlas.row_direction: increasing source mapY; no implicit vertical flip

material_selector.byte_layout: bits0..2 primary triangle material-set ID; bits3..5 second triangle material-set ID; bit6 alternate diagonal; ID7 means no owner

texture_alpha_policy: Preserve original diffuse alpha. It is shader height-blend input; old opaque-forcing decoding is unsuitable.
limits: Global atlas drops duplicated internal border samples; mismatch audit must be reviewed before rendering.
Reference material selector recovers native per-triangle membership; renderer may duplicate ground draws per set and discard fragments whose selector differs.
No draw regrouping was applied; selector method avoids moving/splitting existing geometry. Geometry-height differences remain separate.
No texture files are decoded or copied here; eight IDs and exact UV scales per material set are emitted.
